authors: Awad, H. P. and Glynn, P. W.
title: On the Theoretical Comparison of Low-Bias Steady-State Estimators
venue: ACM Transactions on Modeling and Computer Simulation 17(1), article 4, 30 pages
annotation: Theorem 2.8 gives the classical second-order scalar variance correction for nonstationary Markov processes through Poisson solutions. The finite-chain covariance note specializes and polarizes this coefficient and supplies explicit uniform-in-prior, all-maturity error bounds.

title: Contributions to the Theory of Optimal Control
venue: Boletín de la Sociedad Matemática Mexicana 5:102-119
annotation: Introduces the state-space controllability and observability viewpoint. The yield-curve note turns its finite-horizon observability Gramian into the Fisher information for a continuously observed maturity response.

title: Controllability and Observability Conditions of Linear Autonomous Systems
annotation: Gives the spectral observability criterion used here to characterize the null space of the continuous-maturity Fisher Gramian, including nondiagonalizable generators.

authors: Schmerling, E., Janson, L. and Pavone, M.
title: Optimal sampling-based motion planning under differential constraints: The drift case with linear affine dynamics
venue: 54th IEEE Conference on Decision and Control:2574-2581
annotation: Uses controllability indices to prove the multi-input small-time Gramian eigenvalue orders. The yield-curve note supplies the shifted-response powers and explicit leading block constants for its continuous-maturity Fisher matrix.

title: Two-term small-time spectral expansions for controllability Gramians
annotation: Derives the small-time odd-power eigenvalue hierarchy and refined spectral expansions for controllable single-input Gramians. The yield-curve Fisher response vanishes once more at zero maturity, shifting the hierarchy from powers 1,3,... to 3,5,...; the note gives the corresponding factorial-Hilbert leading constants directly.

authors: Kipnis, C. and Varadhan, S. R. S.
title: Central limit theorem for additive functionals of reversible Markov processes and applications to simple exclusions
annotation: Proves the central limit theorem for time integrals of a function of a reversible Markov process, with the long-run variance given through the resolvent; the reversibility assumption is essential to the proof.

title: Essai expérimental et analytique sur les lois de la dilatabilité des fluides élastiques et sur celles de la force expansive de la vapeur de l'eau et de la vapeur de l'alcool, à différentes températures
annotation: Introduces the annihilating-polynomial reconstruction now known as Prony's method; the finite-atomic Cox-mixture result uses its Hankel and Vandermonde steps.

title: On inverses of Vandermonde and confluent Vandermonde matrices
annotation: Derives inverse-norm bounds for Vandermonde and confluent Vandermonde matrices; the finite-atomic moment Jacobian is exactly a weighted confluent Vandermonde matrix.

title: Central limit theorems for local martingales
venue: Zeitschrift für Wahrscheinlichkeitstheorie und Verwandte Gebiete 51:269-286
annotation: Gives central limit criteria for local martingales in terms of predictable quadratic variation and negligible jumps; the weighted fast-chain clock limit is a bounded-jump specialization.
